_comment: Payments taken OUTSIDE EasyPay, entered by hand. Lumino carries a handful of
pay-by-link payments and has no integration, so its seven payments since
1 July are recorded here rather than left out of revenue entirely.
Each entry: date (the day the client was charged), client (must match the
client's name in the master sheet), amount in dollars, source, note.
The report totals these into Revenue like any other payment, and says on the
page how much of the total was entered by hand.
Add new Lumino payments here. If Lumino ever gets an API, this file is
replaced by a sync and can be deleted.
